name: Strange Attractor
desc: A luminous Clifford strange-attractor point-cloud whose coefficients morph over minutes, leaving additive glow trails; energy sets exposure, with plasma, thermal false-color, wireframe-contour, blueprint and sumi-ink render modes.

energy.doc: exposure: trail brightness + point count + dot size (primary look control)

density.doc: iterated point count per frame (cloud density)

style.doc: render philosophy: additive glow / heat false-color / continuous contour line / schematic dots / sumi stipple

act.doc: multi-minute dramaturgy: gentle breath / section-driven surges / slow steady drift
